content.short: Etherspot is a wallet infrastructure for developers building in the Ethereum ecosystem.
content.description: Etherspot offers an Account Abstraction SDK that enables multi-chain, self-custodial smart contract wallets for dApps, games, and wallet developers, delivering a frictionless Web3 user experience. The SDK enables Web2-like onboarding inside a self-custodial app, wallet, or game, accelerating new-user onboarding and concealing complex blockchain operations. This is achieved through counter-factual Smart Contract Wallets and a multi-chain relayer infrastructure that abstracts away on-chain details.
